dashboard.displayName: Stemly Production APM & AI Health Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time monitoring and alerting for backend errors, latency, Groq rate limits, fallbacks, and user quotas.

alerts.name: HighHTTPErrorRate
alerts.documentation: Check Cloud Run logs for unhandled exceptions or database connectivity timeouts.

alerts.name: HighLatencyP95
alerts.documentation: Inspect Groq LLM latency or downstream network latency spikes.

alerts.name: GroqDownstreamRateLimited
alerts.documentation: Groq tier quota reached or burst limit saturated. Check GROQ_VISION_API_KEY / GROQ_TEXT_API_KEY tier.

alerts.name: HighFallbackRate
alerts.condition: Degraded fallback responses > 10% of total generation requests
alerts.documentation: Primary Groq model is degraded or offline. Emergency regex fallback is active.

alerts.name: CostAnomalyDailyQuotaSpike
alerts.condition: Aggregate daily LLM token consumption > 150% of 7-day trailing average
alerts.documentation: Verify if single user UID is cycling requests or if abuse prevention is needed.
